title: Being Kind Isn't Always Being Safe: Diagnosing Affective Hallucination in LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates 'Affective Hallucination' in LLMs, defining it as a distinct safety risk grounded in psychological theory and developed in consultation with a clinical expert. The evaluation framework, AHaBench, explicitly incorporates criteria such as 'Professional Role Integrity and Boundary Maintenance' and 'Ethics' (Harmlessness assessment) to assess LLM responses, aiming to ensure psychologically safe and ethically responsible AI systems. This goes beyond a perfunctory 'Ethical Considerations' section, making ethical principles central to the paper's contribution.
